## Main tutorial

### Quick-to-run example

A **simple use-case** that grafts missing taxa on a toy backbone phylogeny is available in the README of the package, and a **full workflow from the data to the checked grafted phylogenies** is presented in the [main workflow tutorial](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/main_workflow.html): `vignette("main_workflow")`.

For more advanced uses, please refer to the tutorials below:

## Which tutorial do I need?

| No. | Category | I want to... | Tutorial |
|:-|:-|:------|:----|
| 1.1 | Inputs | Format my data into `missing_taxa_list` and `total_richness_per_clades` | [`format_inputs`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/format_inputs.html): `vignette("format_inputs")` |
| 1.2 | Inputs | Build stochastic maps (simmaps) of species attributes from tip data with deepSTRAPP | [`prepare_stochastic_maps`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/prepare_stochastic_maps.html): `vignette("prepare_stochastic_maps")` |
| 2 | Main workflow | See a full workflow, from tip data to checked grafted phylogenies | [`main_workflow`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/main_workflow.html): `vignette("main_workflow")` |
| 3.1 | Grafting options | Explore options to graft missing taxa within target clades | [`graft_missing_taxa`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/graft_missing_taxa.html): `vignette("graft_missing_taxa")` |
| 3.2 | Grafting options | Explore options to graft missing clades as sisters of clades of the backbone | [`graft_missing_clades`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/graft_missing_clades.html): `vignette("graft_missing_clades")` |
| 3.3 | Grafting options | Graft both types of missing lineages in one run | [`combine_missing_taxa_and_clades`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/combine_missing_taxa_and_clades.html): `vignette("combine_missing_taxa_and_clades")` |
| 4 | Checks | Check the grafting plan before, and the grafted phylogenies after | [`check_grafting`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/check_grafting.html): `vignette("check_grafting")` |
| 5.1 | Data types | Constrain grafting with biogeographic ranges | [`biogeographic_data`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/biogeographic_data.html): `vignette("biogeographic_data")` |
| 5.2 | Data types | Constrain grafting with several traits | [`multiple_traits`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/multiple_traits.html): `vignette("multiple_traits")` |
| 5.3 | Data types | Constrain grafting with a continuous trait | [`continuous_data`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/continuous_data.html): `vignette("continuous_data")` |
| 6.1 | Uncertainty and scaling | Account for uncertainty (simulations, stochastic maps, backbones), and make runs reproducible with seeds | [`handle_uncertainty`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/handle_uncertainty.html): `vignette("handle_uncertainty")` |
| 6.2 | Uncertainty and scaling | Speed up grafting with parallel computation | [`parallel_grafting`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/parallel_grafting.html): `vignette("parallel_grafting")` |
| 6.3 | Uncertainty and scaling | Resume a crashed or interrupted run | [`resume_run`](https://maeldore.github.io/phylograftR/articles/resume_run.html): `vignette("resume_run")` |
